value.before: Hi, I'm Hale, a kids' year planner, and I've been added to this family group. I can only read and write in this chat, nothing else of yours. There's nothing to sign up for or install, and the family's plan already covers everyone here. If you'd rather I not write to you, just say so in whatever words you like and it only applies to you.
value.question: Who are you in this family, in your own words?
